categories.main_business_segments: The company is a specialized supplier of customized precision stamping new materials, primarily engaged in the research, development, production and sales of precision stamping materials for automotive components. The company also focuses on high-end metal materials in bearing and robotics fields. Main product categories include automotive component precision stamping materials (covering safety systems, seat systems, interior systems, and powertrain systems) and industrial precision stamping materials.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs precision cold rolling and heat treatment as core production processes. Key technologies include intergranular oxide control technology, surface decarburization control technology, and flexible production capabilities. The company utilizes advanced equipment including AGC control systems and hydrogen-filled annealing furnaces. Production methods are characterized by customized design of differentiated process routes based on customer requirements, enabling flexible production of products with varying performance specifications from the same raw materials.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are well-known automotive component suppliers including Schaeffler, Mobil, Magna, Faurecia, Valeo, Purus, Factortur, Fulian Precision, and Shanghai Yanpu. The company indirectly supplies major automotive brands including Tesla, BYD, Huawei (Wenjie), Li Auto, Nio, Xiaomi, Mercedes-Benz, Audi, and BMW. The company is expanding into bearing materials, wind power, precision tools, and emerging fields like humanoid robots.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with headquarters and main production facilities in Suzhou, Jiangsu Province. The company has established a subsidiary in Anhui Province (Anhui Xianglou New Materials) for new production capacity. The company serves customers across major Chinese automotive industrial bases including Northeast, Yangtze River Delta, Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, South China, Central, and Southwest regions. The company is expanding international market presence through overseas customer bases.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream of the supply chain, positioned between raw material suppliers (primarily large steel mills like Baosteel) and downstream customers (automotive component manufacturers and precision stamping enterprises). The company purchases metal blanks and auxiliary materials from upstream suppliers and sells finished precision stamping materials to downstream customers for further processing into automotive components.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic focus includes: (1) Deepening customized upgrades in high-end precision stamping materials; (2) Capturing new energy vehicle market opportunities through lightweight component materials; (3) Expanding into high-end bearing materials and humanoid robot core component materials; (4) Accelerating import substitution of Chinese high-end industrial materials; (5) Pursuing global expansion and internationalization. R&D initiatives focus on advanced material development, process optimization, and applications in emerging fields like humanoid robots and hydrogen energy equipment.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of customized precision stamping materials to automotive component manufacturers and other industrial customers. Revenue is recognized when customers obtain control of goods, typically upon receipt and signature of delivery documents for domestic sales or upon completion of export customs clearance for overseas sales. The company also generates rental income from leasing investment properties. Revenue model is based on product sales with customized pricing reflecting research and development costs, production expenses, process technology, and market supply-demand dynamics.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is the only publicly listed company in the domestic precision stamping materials industry. According to public information, the company ranks in the first tier of domestic competitors in terms of production capacity. The company competes with both domestic and international suppliers, with competitive advantages including superior customer relationships, technical capabilities, quality control, and service responsiveness compared to overseas suppliers. The company faces competition from larger international material suppliers but benefits from faster decision-making and shorter delivery times compared to foreign competitors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company achieved 2024 revenue of RMB 1.485 billion (up 9.74% from 2023's RMB 1.353 billion) and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 206.9 million (up 3.10% from 2023's RMB 200.7 million). Total assets reached RMB 1.976 billion at year-end 2024 (up 4.12% from RMB 1.898 billion in 2023). The company demonstrates steady growth with improving profitability, supported by expanding production capacity and market share gains in the new energy vehicle sector.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company's value proposition centers on: (1) Customized precision stamping materials solving customer pain points in material sourcing; (2) Superior quality and performance stability compared to imported materials; (3) Faster response times and shorter delivery cycles than overseas suppliers; (4) Cost advantages through domestic production and flexible manufacturing; (5) Technical expertise in solving complex material challenges for automotive safety systems and new energy vehicle applications; (6) Comprehensive support including technical consultation and problem-solving during customer production processes. The company differentiates through superior service responsiveness, technical innovation, and ability to meet stringent automotive industry quality standards.
